✅ Secure transfer with a token-based QR code
✅ File dropping directly onto the terminal window

PhoneInfoga is an advanced Go-based framework for gathering information about phone numbers. It collects basic details like country, carrier, and line type, and then uses various OSINT techniques, external APIs, and search engines to find potential VoIP providers or identify owners. It also offers a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use.
